description: Test vectors for the additive-tweak case the spec's parity note describes: a bare identifier read as the even-y (02) point, the secret normalised once, plain additive tweaks on the full point (never re-lifted), the resulting parity (02 or 03) as it arises, and the x-only output with the key a BIP-340 signature of it needs. Test secrets only. Generated by sidestr/spec siding/lib/keys.mjs from siding/test/keys-vectors.json (tested against the official BIP 340, 341 and 86 vectors).

identifier_to_point.name: identifier_to_point_even
identifier_to_point.description: A bare identifier names the even-y point: did:nostr:<x> -> 02 || x (the Multikey is fe70102 || x). The holder's own point has even y; the identifier does not say so.

identifier_to_point.name: identifier_to_point_odd
identifier_to_point.description: A bare identifier names the even-y point: did:nostr:<x> -> 02 || x (the Multikey is fe70102 || x). The holder's own point has odd y; the identifier does not say so.

normalize_once.name: normalize_once_even
normalize_once.description: The secret's point already has even y (02): normalising leaves it as it is.

normalize_once.name: normalize_once_odd
normalize_once.description: The secret's point has odd y (03), so the secret of the point the identifier names is n - d. Done once; the identifier and BIP-340 signatures are unchanged (x(P) = x(-P)).

additive_tweak.name: additive_tweak_even_1
additive_tweak.description: +1 on the full point (02 || x), never re-lifted: P + t*G. The result's parity is whatever it is (02); its x is the taproot output / BIP-340 key.

additive_tweak.name: additive_tweak_even_2
additive_tweak.description: +2 on the full point (02 || x), never re-lifted: P + t*G. The result's parity is whatever it is (03); its x is the taproot output / BIP-340 key.

additive_tweak.name: additive_tweak_even_3
additive_tweak.description: taggedScalar("keys-vectors", "cafe") on the full point (03 || x), never re-lifted: P + t*G. The result's parity is whatever it is (02); its x is the taproot output / BIP-340 key.

signing_key.name: signing_key_even_1
signing_key.description: The chained secret signs for its output: a BIP-340 signature by it (aux_rand all zero) verifies against the x-only output. The sign (d or n - d) is applied inside the signing only; the chain continues from the secret as it is.
